gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-lisu: Wire-bent and bold, Grandstander stamps out letters with tall x-heights and short ascenders, while Noto Sans Lisu stays tidy underneath. Grandstander grabs attention; the sans body quietly carries the detail.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Grandstander sketches every letter as if a pencil never pressed harder, with short ascenders and a tall x-height. Lively up top, approachable below in Noto Sans Lydian: that is the charm.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-mahajan: Grandstander has no thin hairline anywhere, only constant-width lines with short ascenders. And Noto Sans Mahajani lifts its lowercase against the capitals, so the two share a taller, modern stance.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-malayal: Expressive Grandstander has no pinched joints or flared ends. Noto Sans Malayalam fills its lines with big middle-zone letters and generous s bends, which gives that bold heading something friendlier to rest on.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Noto Sans Mandaic lets its curvy letters feel unclamped. Grandstander does loud best, with terminals ending at the width they began, while the body does steady reading with lowercase near capital height.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Noto Sans Marchen stands its small letters nearly capital-sized, with curves that end in clear daylight, under a Grandstander heading. Expect a crisp, clean read that never fights the single-weight heading.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-mayan-n: Expressive, Grandstander draws monoline strokes from stem to serif, while Noto Sans Mayan Numerals runs tall-bodied with a visibly gaping c. Their strength is plain contrast: one loud, one contemporary.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-meetei-: Noto Sans Meetei Mayek reads contemporary and modern, its rounds gapped like a cracked bangle and its lowercase eyes large. Grandstander leads with steady pen pressure; the body handles the quieter work.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-mende-k: Expressive and flat, Grandstander has contrast-free letterforms with short ascenders and a tall x-height. Noto Sans Mende Kikakui lets daylight through every curve, so extended text moves along cleanly.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-meroiti: Grandstander draws tubular strokes like bent copper pipe, with short ascenders and a tall x-height, over Noto Sans Meroitic. The body's lowercase fills the line like capitals, so reading flows easily.
